How the gym works

Your mind is a muscle. A few minutes of practice a day trains it the way the gym trains your body: calmer nerves, a clearer head, and feelings you notice instead of feelings that run you. Start with five free minutes, go deeper with a guided session, and book a human coach when you want one.

01

Mind Reps

Mind Reps. A short audio practice, recorded in a real human voice. Press play, close your eyes, and follow along for three to five minutes. Each day brings one of five practices: Body Scan, Naming, Sealing, Senses, Focus. Free forever. Rooted in Positive Intelligence (PQ) mental fitness training.

Clarity, agency, action — scored from your conversations.

We go to the gym for our bodies. We work on our minds alone, in secret, like it’s something to hide. Oriaya is the gym where mental fitness is the workout, progress is the flex, and every small act is a way of rising into the creator of your own life.
Our story

Why I built Oriaya.

Stanford alum · ICF certified coach · years in corporate

I went to Stanford and spent years working in corporate roles. Later, I became an ICF certified coach. From the outside, my life looked steady. Inside, I was still learning to hear my own voice.

I remember two moments when I felt completely present. One was in Fairbanks, Alaska. I had a clear feeling that my life was truly worth living. Years later, I felt it again in a quiet cabin in Hope Valley, California.

Life changed after my kids were born. I got depressed, and I kept blaming myself. I had been raised in a family that protected me, supported me, and gave me so much. I was optimistic and confident, sure of who I was. So why had I ended up in such terrible situations? I was on call for the kids around the clock, with no help at all, and I needed Tylenol just to fall asleep. I walked into a world that kept closing in on me. It nearly broke me. Luckily, I reached out for help: a psychologist, a therapist, and coaches. Each of them helped. The coaching conversations helped me walk out of it and become the owner and creator of my life again. Over time, I began to see those experiences as a lens. They showed me another way to look at my life and at myself.

That is why I built Oriaya. Coaching changed my life. I want it to change more lives. But it only works if you stay with it. A little bit, every day, until it becomes part of your life. That is what happened for me.

A lot of people start coaching and then stop. Money gets in the way. Life gets in the way. I built a gym, not a luxury. A place you can come back to every day, at a price you can keep paying. I believe coaching is for everyone. When people can stay, that is when it becomes true.

Why the name Oriaya?

Oriaya comes from oriri, to rise. Ori, in Hebrew, is my light. In Yoruba, Ori is the inner self that knows the way, intuition and destiny. A light, rising from within. It felt right for this work.

Questions, answered.

Is Oriaya therapy?

No. Oriaya is coaching for growth and forward motion, with clear scope and safety guardrails. Crisis resources are built in.

Who owns my data?

You do — completely. Your data is never sold, never used for ads, and never shared with anyone else. Download a copy any time, or delete everything. This is the part we are proudest of: in a world that monetizes attention, your inner life stays yours. Oriaya also installs straight from the web, with no App Store download. So there is no cross-app tracking, no 'Allow App to Track' prompt, and no cookie banner, because we use no tracking cookies.

How does pricing work?

Mind Reps are free forever. No catch.

  • Founding monthly$2.99/month
  • Founding yearlyBest value$29/year
  • Regular
  • Weekly$3.99/week
  • Monthly$12.99/month
  • Yearly$99/year
  • Human coaching$120 / $399 per session

Founding price for the first 12 months or first year, then regular price. Pay first, then pick your time. Your Deep Sessions subscription can be cancelled anytime, no lock-in.

When does Oriaya Space open?

It’s our next chapter, not an open location yet. We’re testing demand through early sessions in the Bay Area / Palo Alto area before committing to a permanent space. Join the waitlist to be first in the room.

Why might there be a no-show fee?

On-demand AI sessions never need a reservation. When scheduled sessions with a human coach open, a $10–$15 fee may apply only when someone reserves a spot and doesn’t show up or arrives very late. The idea is to protect the coach’s time and open the slot for someone else. It would be a fairness rule, never a profit mechanism.

Do I have to share anything?

Never. Sharing is 100% opt-in, and you decide exactly what leaves your private practice.

Who is it for?

For anyone living in this noisy era who still wants to hear their own voice. For the ones who are done merely surviving and ready to become the creator of their own life. If you're reaching for self-awareness and change, you belong here. Welcome home.
